This plot is rented, so I must make it productive to cover the rent and still feed my family, but I cannot risk too much money on costly inputs. I will apply both the chemical fertilizer I get from the cooperative and manure from my animals to keep the soil strong, and I will use improved seed because it gives better yield. We will work this plot mostly with our own hands, but I will hire a few extra workers when the planting and harvesting times come because my sons are not always here.
